title: Chickpea and aubergine curry
summary: Chickpea and aubergine curry is a indian dinner built around canned chickpeas in water and aubergines, with the portions weighed so each serving stays under 700 kcal.

steps.instruction: Warm the oil and soften the onion for Chickpea and aubergine curry. Stir in the garlic, ginger and spices until they smell fragrant.
steps.tip: If the spices look dusty, give them a minute in the oil before any liquid goes in.

steps.instruction: Add canned chickpeas in water and cook until it loses its raw look. Pour in the tomatoes or coconut and aubergines.
Simmer gently, lid ajar, until chopped tomatoes is tender and the sauce coats a spoon. Add a splash of water if it sticks.
steps.tip: Taste Chickpea and aubergine curry before serving and add a squeeze of lemon if it wants brightness.

steps.instruction: Taste for salt and acid, then rest the pan for a couple of minutes before serving Chickpea and aubergine curry.
